title: PQC Hash Commitment in X.509 Certificates (PQCHC) — draft-vicente-lamps-pqchc
description: Source repository for the IETF Internet-Draft draft-vicente-lamps-pqchc. Defines the PQC Hash Commitment (PQCHC) X.509 v3 extension enabling quantum-resistant hash-based commitment binding in certificate issuance. IETF LAMPS Working Group. Patent-pending: USPTO 64/080,137 (2026-06-01), 19/698,870 (2026-06-05). PEN: 1.3.6.1.4.1.65953.
